events.title: Patriarch Eutychius is arrested after defying Justinian I
events.description: Eutychius, patriarch of Constantinople, refused Emperor Justinian I's order to adopt the beliefs of the Aphthartodocetae, a non-Chalcedonian sect. Soldiers seized him while he was celebrating the feast of Saint Timothy in the church beside the Hormisdas Palace.

events.title: Heraclius crowns his infant son Heraclius Constantine co-emperor
events.description: In Constantinople, Emperor Heraclius crowned his eight-month-old son Heraclius Constantine as Augustus, his co-emperor. As Constantine III he later reigned alone for three months in 641.

events.title: Ottomans defeat the Mamluks at Ridaniya outside Cairo
events.description: Selim I's army, with superior artillery and firearms, crushed the Mamluk forces just outside Cairo. The victory ended the Mamluk Sultanate and brought Egypt, Syria and the Hejaz under Ottoman rule.

events.title: British defeat the French at Wandiwash
events.description: Sir Eyre Coote's East India Company army beat the Comte de Lally's French force in the Carnatic. The battle effectively ended French hopes of empire in India.
events.html: Sir Eyre Coote's East India Company army beat the Comte de Lally's French force in the Carnatic. The battle effectively ended French hopes of empire in India.

events.title: Zulu army destroys a British force at Isandlwana
events.description: Some 20,000 Zulu warriors overran a British camp at Isandlwana, killing over 1,300 soldiers and African auxiliaries. It was one of the worst defeats of the British army in the colonial era.

events.title: Queen Victoria dies at Osborne House
events.description: Victoria died on the Isle of Wight aged 81 after reigning for 63 years, then the longest reign in British history. Her son succeeded as Edward VII.
events.html: Victoria died on the Isle of Wight aged 81 after reigning for 63 years, then the longest reign in British history. Her son succeeded as Edward VII.

events.title: Bloody Sunday in St Petersburg sparks revolution
events.description: Imperial troops fired on unarmed workers led by Father Georgy Gapon marching to petition Tsar Nicholas II, killing many. The massacre set off the 1905 Revolution and badly damaged faith in the Tsar.

events.title: Allied troops land at Anzio
events.description: In Operation Shingle, Allied forces landed behind German lines south of Rome, hoping to outflank the Gustav Line. Quickly contained, they endured four months of hard fighting before breaking out.

events.title: US Supreme Court decides Roe v. Wade
events.description: By seven votes to two, the Court ruled that the constitutional right to privacy protected a woman's decision to have an abortion. The ruling was overturned in 2022.
